source: Department of Agricultural Extension (នាយកដ្ឋានផ្សព្វផ្សាយកសិកម្ម), Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Cambodia — booklet 'ដំណាំពោត' (Corn Crop), Issue 1, 2003, funded by Asian Development Bank (ADB), Loan/Grant No. 1445-CAM(SF), section V: Harvesting ('ការប្រមូលផល')
text: Harvesting is carried out according to the characteristics of each corn variety, so timing can vary. As a general rule of thumb, farmers can judge that corn is ready by observing the husk: when the husk turns brown/dry along with the kernels also drying and hardening, this indicates the crop is ready for full harvest. At harvest, kernel moisture content is typically around 25%.
